name: Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 Unique Maps)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: 14 playable levels across Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea with custom pixel-art biome textures, thumbnails, and 3D landmarks.
description: Standalone regional levels expansion adding all 7 Gen 3-9 regions to PokéBonk's Map Picker with 2 distinct maps each (14 levels total). Every map features custom PokéBonk-style pixel-art terrain, cliff, path, and prop textures, bespoke Map Picker artwork, accurate biome lighting and weather pools, sanctuary arenas, regional encounters, and textured 3D centerpiece landmarks with authentic props. Works completely standalone with vanilla Kanto/Johto Pokémon or paired with National Dex Expansion (Gen 3-9).
highlights: Hoenn: Petalburg Canopy & Mt. Chimney Caldera
Sinnoh: Mt. Coronet Spear Pillar & Eterna Forest Chateau
Unova: Desert Resort Relic Castle & Dragonspiral Tower
Kalos: Azure Bay Sea Arch & Reflection Cave Prisms
Alola: Melemele Tapu Ruins & Wela Volcano Fire Altar
Galar: Galar Wild Area Dynamax Den & Crown Tundra Temple
Paldea: Asado Desert Titan Mesa & Area Zero Terastal Spire
requirements: Offline Mode (Mod Engine ON; works standalone or with National Dex Gen 3-9)
